\section[(dialogue)]{The house and clothes — a first pass}

\label{lesson:PA-R125-first-pass-the-house-and-clothes}



\begin{quote}
Say the words for cumin and a fritter.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{Your turn}
Say these aloud:

\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item rubbish, a basket, a box, a clay water pot, a candle
  \item matches, a carpet, a pillow, a doll, a toy
  \item a cot, pyjamas, a salwar, a scarf, a belt
  \item a handkerchief, a sweater, a coat, a ring, a bangle
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
Rubbish? (\textbf{\pa{ਕੂੜਾ}}, \emph{kūṛā}.) A basket? (\textbf{\pa{ਟੋਕਰੀ}}, \emph{ṭokrī}.) A box? (\textbf{\pa{ਡੱਬਾ}}, \emph{ḍabbā}.) A clay water pot? (\textbf{\pa{ਘੜਾ}}, \emph{ghaṛā}.) A candle? (\textbf{\pa{ਮੋਮਬੱਤੀ}}, \emph{mombattī}.) Matches? (\textbf{\pa{ਮਾਚਿਸ}}, \emph{mācis}.) A carpet? (\textbf{\pa{ਗਲੀਚਾ}}, \emph{galīcā}.) A pillow? (\textbf{\pa{ਸਿਰਹਾਣਾ}}, \emph{sirhāṇā}.) A doll? (\textbf{\pa{ਗੁੱਡੀ}}, \emph{guḍḍī}.) A toy? (\textbf{\pa{ਖਿਡੌਣਾ}}, \emph{khiḍauṇā}.) A cot? (\textbf{\pa{ਮੰਜਾ}}, \emph{mañjā}.) Pyjamas? (\textbf{\pa{ਪਜਾਮਾ}}, \emph{pajāmā}.) A salwar? (\textbf{\pa{ਸਲਵਾਰ}}, \emph{salvār}.) A scarf? (\textbf{\pa{ਚੁੰਨੀ}}, \emph{cunnī}.) A belt? (\textbf{\pa{ਪੇਟੀ}}, \emph{peṭī}.) A handkerchief? (\textbf{\pa{ਰੁਮਾਲ}}, \emph{rumāl}.) A sweater? (\textbf{\pa{ਸਵੈਟਰ}}, \emph{savaiṭar}.) A coat? (\textbf{\pa{ਕੋਟ}}, \emph{koṭ}.) A ring? (\textbf{\pa{ਅੰਗੂਠੀ}}, \emph{angūṭhī}.) A bangle? (\textbf{\pa{ਕੰਗਣ}}, \emph{kangaṇ}.)
\end{tcolorbox}
\section[(dialogue)]{Clothes and food — a second pass}

\label{lesson:PA-R125-second-pass-clothes-and-food}



\begin{quote}
Say the words for an earring and a steel bracelet.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{Your turn}
Say these aloud:

\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item an earring, a steel bracelet, jaggery, chickpeas, mung beans
  \item millet, wheat, maize, an aubergine, a cauliflower
  \item garlic, ginger, a coconut, a watermelon, a papaya
  \item a guava, peanuts, cooked greens, lassi, rice pudding
  \item halwa, spice, turmeric, cumin, a fritter
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
An earring? (\textbf{\pa{ਵਾਲੀ}}, \emph{vālī}.) A steel bracelet? (\textbf{\pa{ਕੜਾ}}, \emph{kaṛā}.) Jaggery? (\textbf{\pa{ਗੁੜ}}, \emph{guṛ}.) Chickpeas? (\textbf{\pa{ਛੋਲੇ}}, \emph{chole}.) Mung beans? (\textbf{\pa{ਮੂੰਗੀ}}, \emph{mū̃gī}.) Millet? (\textbf{\pa{ਬਾਜਰਾ}}, \emph{bājrā}.) Wheat? (\textbf{\pa{ਕਣਕ}}, \emph{kaṇak}.) Maize? (\textbf{\pa{ਮੱਕੀ}}, \emph{makkī}.) An aubergine? (\textbf{\pa{ਬੈਂਗਣ}}, \emph{baĩgaṇ}.) A cauliflower? (\textbf{\pa{ਗੋਭੀ}}, \emph{gobhī}.) Garlic? (\textbf{\pa{ਲਸਣ}}, \emph{lasaṇ}.) Ginger? (\textbf{\pa{ਅਦਰਕ}}, \emph{adrak}.) A coconut? (\textbf{\pa{ਨਾਰੀਅਲ}}, \emph{nārīal}.) A watermelon? (\textbf{\pa{ਤਰਬੂਜ਼}}, \emph{tarbūz}.) A papaya? (\textbf{\pa{ਪਪੀਤਾ}}, \emph{papītā}.) A guava? (\textbf{\pa{ਅਮਰੂਦ}}, \emph{amrūd}.) Peanuts? (\textbf{\pa{ਮੂੰਗਫਲੀ}}, \emph{mū̃gphalī}.) Cooked greens? (\textbf{\pa{ਸਾਗ}}, \emph{sāg}.) Lassi? (\textbf{\pa{ਲੱਸੀ}}, \emph{lassī}.) Rice pudding? (\textbf{\pa{ਖੀਰ}}, \emph{khīr}.) Halwa? (\textbf{\pa{ਹਲਵਾ}}, \emph{halvā}.) Spice? (\textbf{\pa{ਮਸਾਲਾ}}, \emph{masālā}.) Turmeric? (\textbf{\pa{ਹਲਦੀ}}, \emph{haldī}.) Cumin? (\textbf{\pa{ਜੀਰਾ}}, \emph{jīrā}.) A fritter? (\textbf{\pa{ਪਕੌੜਾ}}, \emph{pakauṛā}.)
\end{tcolorbox}
